t: This was Sex, a boutique at 430 King's Road that ran from 1974 to 1976. Vivienne Westwood and her then-partner Malcolm McLaren ran it, and it specialised in clothing that defined the look of punk. McLaren, an English fashion designer and entrepreneur, went on to manage punk and new wave bands including the Sex Pistols, the New York Dolls, Adam and the Ants and Bow Wow Wow. He is counted as an early influence on the punk subculture.
